# <span id="aanchor208"></span> Quick Launch Tiles

Use the Dashboard Manager to select which tiles will display on your main screen.

<div class="procedure">

To add or remove a dashboard tile:

1.  Click the gear icon 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> in the top right corner of the Main Screen to open the Settings menu.

2.  Click **Dashboard Manager**.

3.  Click **Quick Launch Tiles**.

4.  A list of tiles is available in the left column of the screen. The tiles currently on your dashboard are in the right column of the screen. Drag and drop items from one column to the other to add or remove tiles from your dashboard.

    The order of tiles in this window does not reflect the order in which they will display on your dashboard. You can arrange the tile order directly from the main screen.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 550;height: 414;" />

</div>

The TESTit tile is available for both TESTit 2 and TEST 3 Integrated. For TESTit 2, the database must be set to TESTit 2 and the associated files must be available within the FLOWCAL directory. For TESTit 3, the database must be set to TESTit 3 and the install path must be defined in the TESTit_Config.cfg file in the FLOWCAL directory. For the TESTit 3 tile to display, the path in the TESTit_Config.cfg must include the Bin folder that contains the TESTit.exe file (example: C:\Apps\TESTit\Bin).

#### See also:

[Arranging and Customizing Tiles](Arranging%20Customizing%20Tiles.md)

</div>
